asked.item: Credit cost of Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 image-to-video at 1080p

verdict.reason: S31 gives the per-second 1080p rate for this model, and S53 says where to see the cost before generating.

steps.text: The google/gemini-omni-flash/v1.1/image-to-video model costs 50 credits per second at 1080p, so multiply that by your clip length in seconds.
To see the credit cost before you generate, click a GREEN clip (image) or PURPLE clip (video), and the cost appears right above the "Regenerate" button.
